description: Closed catalog of explicit, change-scoped hosted CI packs. Candidate identity is bound at dispatch time.

admission_checks: DCO check on the exact pull request head
negative_controls: reject unknown pack ID
reject malformed or mismatched candidate SHA
reject missing required pack fields
reject a candidate surface with no named focused job
reject a critical-surface downgrade

exact_sha.binding: must equal HEAD of the isolated candidate checkout, controlled by the protected-main workflow
exact_sha.target_base_sha: required workflow_dispatch input target_base_sha; must equal merge-base(candidate_sha, trusted_main_sha) and differ from candidate_sha; bootstrap when candidate_sha equals trusted_main_sha uses candidate first parent
